statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 meeting HIPAA and the GLBA Safeguards Rule
Group CISO accountable; covered entities name security and privacy officials; College Qualified Individual reports to the board each year
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up; College analysis written with 314.4(b)(1) criteria
Risk acceptance authority by level; High patient-safety risks must be treated
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Common control catalog; each division documents inheritance and confirms it each year
Sanctions documented; student violations end rotation access
No contract, no data: BAAs for PHI; safeguards and FERPA redisclosure terms for College service providers
Internal audit assesses common controls yearly and samples divisions; annual penetration test including the College from 2027
Retain security documentation 6 years
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard before use or material change
Medical device inventory, security review before purchase, unsupported devices in restricted zones
IT contingency plans are annexes of the unified emergency preparedness program; cyber hazards in its risk assessments
Unique identities; shared accounts prohibited; College onto SYS-G1 by 2027-06-30
Role-based least privilege; owner approval; other covered entity's PHI only through approved protocols
MFA for remote, email, privileged, and College customer-information systems; badge and PIN at clinical workstations
Students, trainees, agency, and locum staff only through identity governance with end dates, MFA, and training first
Disable access within 4 hours of termination; schools and agencies report withdrawals within 1 business day
Quarterly access certification including privileged, service, student, and vendor accounts
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM with recording
Lockout, workstation lock, and session timeouts
Sealed break-glass accounts tested quarterly and reviewed after use
All vendor access, including device vendors, through PAM with MFA and per-session approval; no persistent connections after 2026-12-31
Service accounts owned, vaulted, rotated every 90 days, and certified
MFA offered on external portals; required for brokers and community-connect users
Report suspected incidents to the SOC within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks; College plan replaced by 2026-12-31
Record discovery dates per entity (164.404(a)(2), 164.410(a)(2), 16 CFR 314.4(j)(2))
Each covered entity's own four-factor assessment and notices; business associate notices within BAA terms and 60 days
Multi-regulator notification matrix including insurance commissioners, FSA, and FTC; quarterly review; counsel approves notices
Patient safety first: downtime, hospital incident command, diversion criteria, EMTALA screening continues
Severity 1 to the disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K within 4 business days after a materiality determination
Ransom payment needs board risk committee approval and an OFAC check
Annual cross-division exercise with downtime, the matrix, and a materiality decision; counts as the hospitals' additional exercise
Evidence preservation and legal hold
Lessons learned within 30 days; update registers, POA&M, and the emergency plan
Four classes; Restricted covers PHI, member NPI, student records and customer information, credentials, keys
Encrypt Restricted information at rest and in transit; no unencrypted email
Written minimum-necessary protocol for every routine feed between the covered entities; Health Plan documents purposes
Education records disclosed only with consent or a FERPA exception; rosters only through the secure feed
Immutable backups in a separate provider or account; quarterly restore tests; annual full restore of High clinical systems
Sanitize or destroy media with certificates
Retention schedule; College customer information disposed within 2 years after last use unless needed
Paper downtime records tracked, entered within 24 hours of recovery, and destroyed securely
No Restricted information in unapproved AI tools
Acknowledge the policy at hire and yearly; students at each rotation
Training at hire and yearly; monthly phishing exercises in all divisions; students trained before activation
Role-based training for clinical, EHR security, downtime, and financial aid staff
Generative AI only from the approved-tools list
No patient information in course work or the LMS; de-identified case material only
Badge out of shared workstations; no clinical decision support changes outside change control
